# R53 / Shaft

*R53 / Shaft Multiple Assigner State Machine Diagram — version 3.2.4, May 12, 2019*

<!-- generated from R53.xsm - do not edit -->

Rows are the wait states. A cell marked **?** is an interaction event with no declared response — it defaults to can't happen, but nobody has said why. A blank cell is a completion event that cannot be received here.

The transient states — `Search for new destination`, `Search for alternate destination` — accept only their own completion event; every other event can't happen.

## State transition table

| | Service requested | Transfer completed |
|---|---|---|
| **NO TRANSFER** | **Search for new destination** | can't happen |
| **TRANSFER IN PROGRESS** | **Search for alternate destination** | **Search for new destination** |

`No destination`, `Transfer created`, `Dest change evaluated` are answered only by a transient state, so those columns are omitted.

## Non transition event responses

### NO TRANSFER

| Event | Response | Explanation |
|---|---|---|
| Transfer completed | can't happen | There is no Transfer instance in this state, so one cannot complete. |

### TRANSFER IN PROGRESS

*Every event is either a transition or a systematic can't happen.*
